bandReport.notes: Band covers items 81-100 (the last 20 items of the paper). Item 81 is the first item at the top of page 18 c1 and is whole; item 100 is the last item on page 21 c2 and is whole (stem, all four statements and all four options present, nothing follows it on the page). Page layout: p18 = 81,82,83 | 84,85; p19 = 86,87 | 88,89,90; p20 = 91,92,93 | 94,95,96; p21 = 97,98 | 99,100. No item spans the gutter and no item spans a page break. Column crops: on all four pages the c1 crop runs a little past the gutter and includes a narrow sliver of c2 showing only the bold item numbers (84./85., 88./89./90., 94./95., 99./100.) with no c2 body text; correspondingly the c2 crops clip the leading digit of their own item numbers (they read '4.', '5.', '8.', '9.', '0.' etc.). No body text is lost either way, and the c1 slivers independently confirm each c2 item number. No page needed to be re-read from pNN.png, though pNN.png was used to confirm structure on p18 and p21. Item 94 prints the title with a macron: "Yogavasistha" is set as Yogavāsistha; the diacritic is transcribed as printed. Item 99 prints a double space between 'tool' and 'to' ('a tool  to :'); normalised to a single space as ordinary line spacing. Items 98 and 99 print an identical option set ((a) 1 only / (b) 3 only / (c) 1 and 2 / (d) 2 and 3) but have different stems - transcribed as printed. Nothing was genuinely illegible at this scan resolution; the digit-bearing option blocks of items 83 and 100 and all four pair tables (87, 88, 91, 92) were re-read at 2.6-3x magnification to confirm digits and single letters.
